registration_boundary.purpose: Freeze downloaded-source fingerprints, database resolution, structural census, blind preparation, runtime, prompt serialization, and selector interpretations before loading either neural model for HoVer scoring.

frozen_adapter_interpretation.normalization: Collapse Unicode whitespace and trim titles, claims, and article text; title and article are joined with one newline before tokenization.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.top20_membership: Read only doc_retrieval_results[0][0][:20], normalize titles, and deduplicate in released order before any gold join.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.database_resolution: Resolve normalized official titles by exact documents.id lookup; all 42,260 requested unique titles resolved and no title is replaced.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.source_order: Sort resolved documents by SHA-256 of normalized title before assigning neutral source ordinals.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.candidate_id: case_id + SHA-256-sorted neutral source ordinal + zero-based chunk ordinal; labels, hops, public titles, and gold units are absent.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.chunking: Encode normalized title-plus-article without special tokens; emit [start:start+384] at stride 320; decode with skip_special_tokens=true and clean_up_tokenization_spaces=false.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.token_cost: Number of pre-decode content token IDs in the chunk.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.gold_unit: One unique normalized supporting-document title; assign a neutral gold ordinal after SHA-256 sorting only in the gold object.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.candidate_ceiling: Gold supporting-document fraction present among resolved frozen top-20 titles; missing gold remains in the recall denominator.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.blind_cache: Prepared and scored caches contain claim/candidate text only as ignored runtime inputs; label, num_hops, supporting_facts, public titles, gold units, and candidate-gold flags are absent.
frozen_adapter_interpretation.gold_join: All seven methods emit candidate IDs for every budget before label, hop, supporting-document units, or candidate ceiling are joined for evaluation.

frozen_scoring_execution.score_calibration: Per-case min-max independently for BM25, dense, hybrid, direct cross-encoder, and each role prompt.
frozen_scoring_execution.role_pair_query_template: {registered role prompt} + one space + 'Claim: ' + normalized public claim

frozen_selector_execution.frc_rule: Identical v34 thresholded role-coverage greedy rule for both role families; threshold 0.55, role coverage weight 2, direct cross-encoder relevance weight 1, ascending candidate-id final tie break.
frozen_selector_execution.only_frc_difference: The four registered role prompts and resulting role-score keys; all selector operations, thresholds, relevance scores, budgets, feasibility scans, and ties are identical.
frozen_selector_execution.hard_budget_behavior: All methods skip infeasible ranked candidates, return at most five chunks, and never exceed the requested token budget.

frozen_evaluation_execution.recall_denominator: all unique public supporting-document gold units, including units missing from the frozen top-20 candidate pool
frozen_evaluation_execution.safety_delta: frc_verification_roles_v39 minus the strongest non-FRC baseline within each budget or supported stratum

stopping_and_output.gate_boundary: The result cannot by itself change Gate 2, authorize CANARY/DEFAULT, reproduce SetR, or establish flood-domain effectiveness.
